title: Balanced Totems
description: Makes Totems Of Undying more balanced!
body:
Description

This datapack basically balances Totems of undying by not giving you any effects after you pop the totem.

It does not give u the fire res effect!

It does not give u the regen effect!

It does not give u the absorption effect!

And leaves you at just half a heart.

This makes Totems more balanced as you can still die if ur constantly being attacked but if u take fall damage or something u survive with half a heart.

Installation

Go to minecraft folder then go to saves (your world name) →datapacks and then upload this datapack in that folder

Disclaimer: Do not extract this file! Unless you know what you are doing.
